title: /harness/reports/[id]
responsibility: Redirects a former report page to the explorer: Pages at the commit the report names when this history holds it, else Pages at the branch tip.

inputs.name: load.params
inputs.description: The route id is passed to repository.get and, when that lookup rejects, used as the id in reportDestination’s fallback report object. This loader accepts it as a string without validating its format.

outputs.name: load
outputs.description: The async load handler has no normal resolved value: after its data-loading and parsing steps, it calls redirect(307, ...) and throws the redirect control-flow result. The redirect target is /harness followed by reportDestination’s result for the loaded index and report, or the route id fallback when report lookup rejects.

errors.name: consoleData.json rejection
errors.description: A rejection from consoleData.json('index.json') propagates through Promise.all because this loader does not catch that promise. The rejection can occur before the redirect is reached.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse(stored) throws SyntaxError when the stored index value is truthy but is not valid JSON. Falsy stored values skip parsing.

errors.name: Redirect 307
errors.description: After Promise.all resolves and any truthy stored index parses, redirect(307, ...) throws the 307 redirect to /harness plus the destination returned by reportDestination. A rejection from repository.get is caught and converted to null before this step.
